document.about: UN DESA World Economic Situation and Prospects 2025 (212 pages): report tables, a two-column table of minerals and counts.

checks.issue: Table II.1 (page 66) is two columns, minerals and a count. Its header row was read as a field, and the counts had no column name.

Table A.3 runs on over its pages under its title restated at the same place on each (`table A .3`, `Developing economies: growth of real GDP (continued)`, `Annual percentage change`), each part under its header again. The title lines were read as text between the parts, and page 173's part was a table of its own.
